name: Adieu Those In Love
source:
﻿It's the 2000s, and in a certain village, a delinquent has just returned to her new normal life from the detention center for a crime she didn't commit. Little does she know what awaits her...

[From [url=https://occultlily.itch.io/adieu-those-in-love]itch.io[/url]]
